title: Grid-World RL Agent
description: Build a configurable grid-world environment and train tabular control agents (value iteration, Q-learning, SARSA) on it, comparing learning curves under a fixed seeded protocol and analyzing stochasticity and reward-shaping effects.
learningObjectives: Formalize an MDP with explicit transition and reward definitions
Implement value iteration and two temporal-difference agents
Compare convergence under identical seeds and stochasticity
Explain the effect of reward shaping with evidence

milestones.title: Configurable grid world
milestones.objective: Implement a deterministic-seed grid world with walls, stochastic slips, and terminal states.
milestones.expectedOutput: Env that passes determinism tests given the same seed.

milestones.title: Value iteration reference
milestones.objective: Implement value iteration as an optimal-solver reference point.
milestones.expectedOutput: Optimal value function and policy on a small world.

milestones.title: Q-learning & SARSA
milestones.objective: Train both agents with epsilon-greedy policies; run the fixed seeded protocol.
milestones.expectedOutput: Learning curves over the same number of steps.

milestones.title: Stochasticity & shaping analysis
milestones.objective: Compare performance with and without slips; test one reward-shaping change and its effects.

categories.minimumExpectation: Value iteration matches manual solution on a tiny world
categories.excellentExpectation: Property tests for determinism and slip behavior

categories.minimumExpectation: Named seeds and steps in the report

categories.excellentExpectation: Shaping ablation with a causal explanation
Env editor docs enabling new worlds

constraints: Single source of randomness per agent
hints: Sanity-check Q-learning convergence against value iteration on the identical small world first
